Pattern poured in crema with steamed milk.

How Latte art connects

  • Topic: Barista — Latte art is the poured signature of specialty baristas.
  • Item: Cappuccino — Latte art is poured onto milk drinks such as cappuccino.

What is Latte art?

Latte art — rosettas, hearts, tulips — is the visible skill mark of the specialty barista, a foam signature on cappuccino and flat whites.

Key threads lead to Barista and Cappuccino.
